title: Transcriptional profiling of the tuberculin skin test in patients with active and latent tuberculosis
description: Transcriptome at the site of a 48 hour tuberculin skin test (TST) and saline injection from patients with active TB disease and latent TB infection

samples.title: Sample 190_TT14SAL
samples.description: Protocols: TSTs were performed by intradermal injection of 2U Tuberculin (Serum Statens Institute) into the forearm. 3-mm punch skin biopsies were taken at 48h andc ollected into RNAlater (Qiagen) for RNA extraction. Total RNA from skin biopsies was obtained with the Precellys Evolution homogeniser and Qiagen RNeasy mini kit. The KAPA mRNA HyperPrep Kit (Roche Diagnostics) was used to construct stranded mRNA-Seq libraries from up to 500 ng intact total RNA
